planets.name: HD 135694 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 135694 with a 15.9-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: HD 135694 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 135694. Its orbit and size follow Crossfield et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
